- Top-tier model performance has converged to the point where the 'best' model depends on the specific task, making system architecture — not model selection — the critical differentiator (Source: blog.mean.ceo, April 2026)
- AI models now score 83% on GDPVal, a benchmark testing AI against real professional work across 44 occupations, matching or exceeding human expert performance in areas including financial modeling (Source: blog.mean.ceo, April 2026)
